scenario: [LGRA.5.11]'s boundary: "A schema has at most 255 slots", so schema `S` of exactly 255 slots, `s1` to `s255`, compiles. Its slots take the indexes 0 to 254, every one a byte can hold beside the reserved 255 ([RDSC.4a.9.1]). PATH: `dsc.validate.lgra_5_11_slot_count` counts the schema's fields and finds none past 255, and `dsc.lower` numbers each slot by its position. Break: a compiler whose limit is lower refuses this; one that admits 256 passes its pair, LGRA.5.11_schema_256_slots_refused.
